text_to_speech: Within within the amount of like eight weeks there was enough Dogecoin going around and it had sufficient value for people to be sponsoring Olympic teams with tens of thousands of dollars. What happened there? How did this thing become such a hit? I think it was the right place right time thing. At the end of 2013, that was kind of Bitcoin's first big run-up and you know I think it hit $1000 and everybody was super excited. At that point of time there was so much interest in crypto. But the difference between say 2013 and 2017 is that all the people that were interested in it went just speculators, they were developers. I think when when Dogecoin came out and it was on BitcoinTalk which is obviously very popular with with developers and people that are more technical in nature, there was just this community of people that were like "hey finally here is like a thing we can play around with." I think that Dogecoin didn't have any value at that point, it wasn't on an exchange or anything like that. And so people were like "hey like this is a cool way that we can learn how to interface with say the bitcoind json-rpc." We can do all this stuff with a real live mainnet without the worry of losing money on the Bitcoin mainnet, especially at the time because Bitcoin was so expensive. So I just think was a right place right time thing. And very quickly after it launched, within 24 hours the hash rate was just like it was it was too much you couldn't solo mine anymore. You had to pool mine. All these pools popped up, the tip bot on Reddit popped up in the space of about a week after it launched. And I think it was just because, right place right time, like the developers were there and ready to go.

youtube_description:
Within weeks of its initial launch in late 2013, the Dogecoin community was already in the tens of thousands and had organized to sponsor Jamaica's Olympic bobsled team. The success of Dogecoin came at a time when Bitcoin was reaching an important milestone: crossing the $1,000 threshold. Part of Dogecoin's meteoric rise may just have been chance and timing.

Full interview: http://epicenter.tv/280
